```{r}
#| label: lernparadox
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
source(here::here("resources/viz-setup.R"))

quadrants <- tibble(
  xmin = c(0, 5, 0, 5),
  xmax = c(5, 10, 5, 10),
  ymin = c(5, 5, 0, 0),
  ymax = c(10, 10, 5, 5),
  quadrant = c(
    "Produktive\nAnstrengung",
    "Experten-\nEffizienz",
    "Unproduktive\nFrustration",
    "Illusion des\nLernens"
  ),
  fill_color = c(color_positive, color_sky, "#9ca3af", color_negative),
  importance = c("ZIEL", "OK für Fortgeschrittene", "Vermeiden", "Metakognitive Falle")
)

ggplot(quadrants) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = I(fill_color)),
    alpha = 0.3,
    color = brand_dark,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
      y = (ymin + ymax) / 2 + 0.7,
      label = quadrant
    ),
    size = 5.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9,
    color = brand_dark,
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
      y = (ymin + ymax) / 2 - 0.9,
      label = importance
    ),
    size = 3.8,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = brand_dark,
  ) +
  geom_curve(
    data = tibble(x = 8.2, y = 1.8, xend = 1.8, yend = 8.2),
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    curvature = -0.3,
    color = brand_accent,
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  # annotate(
  #   "text",
  #   x = 5, y = 4.3,
  #   label = "Metakognitive Falle",
  #   size = 4.2,
  #   fontface = "bold.italic",
  #   color = brand_accent,
  # ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(2.5, 7.5),
    labels = c("Schwierig", "Leicht"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(2.5, 7.5),
    labels = c("Wenig", "Viel"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Das Lernparadox",
    subtitle = "Subjektives Gefühl und tatsächliches Lernen können auseinanderklaffen",
    x = "\nSubjektives Gefühl beim Lernen",
    y = "Tatsächliches Lernen\n"
  ) +
  theme_workshop() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = brand_dark, linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
```
